proposed_from.topic: Sharp survivor-complier benefit bounds by partial transport. For finite ordered outcomes under conditional IV independence, treatment and outcome consistency and exclusion, instrument overlap, no defiers, positive aggregate survivor-complier mass, and covariate-specific weak selection monotonicity, identify the selected-complier outcome capacities in each covariate cell; prove that the single branch-free exact-mass partial-transport polytope is the exact projection of compatible laws and that the sharp endpoints of P(Y1>Y0 | S1=S0=1,D1>D0) have closed threshold min-cut formulas in both selection directions and on the zero-gap tie face, an O(|X|K) sparse-flow algorithm with O(|X|K^2) dense materialization, and endpoint-attaining full latent IV/selection laws. Estimate the observable capacities with the total nonnegative-projection plug-in estimator; derive its fixed-law Hadamard directional limit under arbitrary simultaneous threshold-cut ties, including positive-survivor zero-gap cells and screened zero-survivor cells; and give the explicit deterministic-guard confidence set whose containment of the entire identified interval tends to one uniformly under overlap and a uniform aggregate survivor-mass bound. Do not claim calibrated face-aware directional-multiplier inference: the multiplier face envelope is diagnostic only, and first-order exact unguarded uniform multiplier calibration under changing survivor support remains an open inference frontier. Include the three-level witness with survivor share 1/2, higher-arm mixture (0.2,0.5,0.3), lower-arm marginal (0.3,0.4,0.3), and sharp benefit interval [0,0.7]. Give a variable-level reinterpretation of the Chen-Flores Job Corps wage application—Z as offer assignment, D as program receipt, S as employment, and Y as an ordered wage category—without claiming an empirical reanalysis or transfer of their published bounds. VERIFIED CORE: using unnormalized cell masses ell_i=P(Y0=i,S0=1,C|x), h_j=P(Y1=j,S1=1,C|x), q0=sum_i ell_i, q1=sum_j h_j, and m=min(q0,q1), the exact projected polytope is Gamma_x*={gamma>=0: row(gamma)<=ell, col(gamma)<=h, sum gamma=m}; the sharp lower benefit mass is max(0,max_t(ell_{<=t}-h_{<=t})+min(q1-q0,0)) and the sharp upper mass is min(m,min_t(ell_{<t}+h_{>t})). These specialize to the directional formulas and agree on the tie face. The supplied witness gives masses 0 and 0.175, hence conditional endpoints 0 and 0.7. Direct full-LP checks matched the formulas on 100 random four-level instances in each direction, and the symbolic proof covers zero-survivor cells, atoms, cut ties, latent-mixture completion, and endpoint-attaining compatible full laws. OPEN INFERENCE FRONTIER: calibrate an estimated-active-face directional multiplier uniformly under simultaneous cut ties and changing survivor support without disguising the deterministic guard as multiplier calibration. EARLY KILL TEST PASSED: the finite-grid latent-type LP comparisons found no projected endpoint differing from the threshold formula.
proposed_from.novelty_justification: DongHeiler2026 sharply bounds an intensive-margin mean by trimming selected-complier mixtures under its Assumption 3.2; it does not couple \(Y_0\) and \(Y_1\) for the same survivor-complier. LuDingDasgupta2018 Proposition 2, equation (6), starts from complete fixed marginals. GabrielSachsJensen2024 Section 3.2, Theorem 2 and Results 3--4 use symbolic response-function restrictions without treatment-induced survivor selection. deAguasEtAl2025 Definitions 1--2 and Propositions 4--5, equations (5)--(8), already bound the same ordered-tier benefit event and Section 5 treats tied-bound nonregularity, but the paper assumes ignorability and complete treatment-arm marginals. The flagship difference is the exact tie-safe projection of unequal IV-identified survivor-complier submeasures to increasing, decreasing, and zero-gap transport faces, closed threshold formulas that agree on the tie face, and a construction showing that both endpoint couplings extend to compatible full IV-selection laws. No structural or support condition is added to the identification law class. The fully specified observed-law witness certifies nonvacuous compatibility. The inferential contribution is limited to a total screened estimator and a fixed-law directional limit; uniform face-aware multiplier coverage remains an open, direction-separated strengthening question.

seed_details.seed: Derive closed threshold-cut endpoints and endpoint-attaining full IV laws for survivor-complier ordinal benefit under covariate-specific weak selection monotonicity.
seed_details.opened_evidence: The introductions, main identification theorems, sharpness constructions, and conclusions were read in arXiv:1704.05706, arXiv:2606.09223, arXiv:1507.01542, and arXiv:2305.10555.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace contaminated-distribution trimming or complete-marginal coupling by projection to unequal survivor-complier submeasures and then prove that extremal subcouplings paste into a full latent IV law.
seed_details.destination_search: Exact searches combining survivor-complier, probability of benefit, ordinal outcomes, selection, and partial transport returned no theorem occupying this target-method pair.
seed_details.referee_objection: The result is immediate from fixed-marginal ordinal bounds after renormalizing the selected-complier distributions.
seed_details.rebuttal: Renormalization invents the missing survivor margin; the unequal observed submeasures impose capacity inequalities, and endpoint sharpness additionally requires a global latent-law completion.

seed_details.seed: Construct uniformly valid simultaneous confidence sets for both benefit endpoints using estimated near-active cuts and zero-cell faces.
seed_details.opened_evidence: The main directional bootstrap theorems and proofs in arXiv:1404.3763, the contact-set theorems in arXiv:0907.3503, and the weak-selection inference theorem and sharpness proof in arXiv:2008.12720 were read.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Estimate a product face containing tied threshold cuts, capacity-cone faces, and cells near zero before applying the common-denominator directional map.
seed_details.destination_search: Searches for uniform inference for finite max-min ratios with changing support found generic directional and intersection-bound methods but no result for this composed two-endpoint functional.
seed_details.referee_objection: This is a direct corollary of Fang and Santos combined with contact-set selection.
seed_details.rebuttal: Neither source treats local zero-cell deletion, an estimated capacity projection, two simultaneous extrema, and a shared random denominator along the same triangular array.

seed_details.seed: Profile survivor-complier benefit under joint compliance-defier and reverse-selection budgets and derive the critical budget where positive benefit vanishes.
seed_details.opened_evidence: The sensitivity parameters, sharp distribution theorem, proof, and conclusion in arXiv:2106.06421 were read together with the survivor and weak-selection constructions in the other anchors.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Profile signed complier-defier and helped-harmed selection capacities before any ordered coupling can be optimized.
seed_details.destination_search: No located paper jointly budgets defiers, reverse selection, and same-unit ordinal benefit in the survivor-complier stratum.
seed_details.referee_objection: This only stacks Noack sensitivity onto generalized Lee bounds.
seed_details.rebuttal: Joint violations destroy nonnegative IV capacities, so sharp profiling and the critical-budget frontier require a new signed partial-transport geometry.

seed_details.seed: Extend directional partial transport to continuous outcomes and \(P(Y_1-Y_0>\delta)\) using a Hall--Strassen dual and a confidence band in \(\delta\).
seed_details.opened_evidence: The Fan--Park abstract, main bound statement, inference discussion, and conclusion were checked from the publisher paper; Russell's transport formulation was checked against the published article metadata and cited theorem descriptions.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace the finite nested-cut network by measure-valued subcoupling duality for a discontinuous threshold cost.
seed_details.destination_search: The located continuous treatment-effect-distribution papers start from complete marginals rather than latent survivor-complier submeasures.
seed_details.referee_objection: Makarov bounds already solve every threshold \(\delta\).
seed_details.rebuttal: Makarov bounds do not choose latent submarginals inside unequal selected-complier mixtures or certify their completion to a full IV-selection law.

seed_details.seed: Impose a survivor-stratum Kendall or Spearman band and prove zero-gap moment-constrained transport bounds with full-law attainment.
seed_details.opened_evidence: The banked proposal README was opened and its failed strong-duality and attainment boundary was traced; Fang--Santos optimal-face resampling was read as the inference exemplar.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: The Ferrers min-cut reduction becomes a moment-constrained transport dual whose closedness and endpoint lifting must be proved.
seed_details.destination_search: The repository predecessor supplies only an outer envelope, and no closer public survivor-complier concordance theorem was found.
seed_details.referee_objection: This merely reruns the failed concordance-band proposal inside another stratum.
seed_details.rebuttal: The seed is credible only if the zero-gap and latent-completion steps close; because those steps remain unresolved it is ranked below the threshold kernel.

seed_details.opened_evidence: The tiered-benefit propositions, extremal-matrix proof, stabilized inference construction, and discussion in arXiv:2502.10049 were read together with the symbolic IV benefit paper.

seed_details.rebuttal: The objection holds for pointwise tiers unless joint sharpness across tiers is added, which is not yet supported by a completion theorem.

seed_details.referee_objection: This is generic robust policy learning after plugging in a new conditional bound.
seed_details.rebuttal: Without a target-specific margin and regret lower bound the objection holds, so the seed is not retained in this version.

seed_details.seed: Characterize when the sharp lower survivor-benefit bound is positive through observable threshold dominance inequalities.
seed_details.opened_evidence: The fixed-marginal sharp bound and triangular construction in arXiv:1507.01542 and the selected-mixture identification proof in arXiv:2606.09223 were read.

seed_details.rebuttal: The objection holds once the threshold formula is available, so this is a corollary rather than an independent kernel.

proposed_from.literature_map: The selected identification seed was deepened along four adjacent threads. Kennedy, Harris, and Keele provide the survivor-complier framing and contaminated-mixture sharpness construction. Dong and Heiler provide the closest weak-selection selected-complier mean model and an explicit trimmed-distribution completion. Lu, Ding, and Dasgupta provide the complete-marginal threshold formula and constructive triangular matrices for strict ordinal benefit. Gabriel, Sachs, and Jensen and de Aguas and coauthors provide symbolic and tiered ordinal-benefit comparators without survivor selection. The inference seed was checked against Fang and Santos for derivative-estimated resampling, Chernozhukov, Lee, and Rosen for near-binding index localization, and Semenova for sign-separated weak-selection ratios. The sensitivity seed was checked against Noack's sharp defier robust region. Exact destination searches found no paper joining latent survivor-complier submeasures, same-unit ordinal benefit, threshold partial transport, full IV-law completion, and two-endpoint tied-face inference.
